content_of_post_to_comment:
I'm 21 years old and my girlfriend of 3 years left me about 4 months ago. I know I'm a loser right now and I want to change, please be kind.

Issue 1: Sleep completely evades me. When I was a teenager I would stay up until 4am playing video games, oftentimes I would stay up further than that and skip school altogether. Living with my partner I kept the habit of being chronically on my phone in bed, and even once I began to overcome it the stress would keep me awake.

It's like my mind just doesn't turn off. I lay down, close my eyes, and the thoughts just keep running. I can't sleep. I've lost jobs over this.

Issue 2: I am overweight, out of shape, and can't stay consistent. Everytime I try to commit to not eating sweets or to exercise, I fail. In fact, I'll do good most of the day then binge eat at the end. It feels like I'll never change or build the body I desire. I also have no idea what I'm doing when it comes to exercise and physical fitness.

Issue 3: I'm broke, beyond broke, and unemployed. Work is just so incredibly boring and slow and even if I could find a job I'm worried about how long I could keep it. I've found an opportunity at a factory but I already can imagine how loud, hot, and slow it's going to be. How do I push through and work for months?

Issue 4: The constant hum of anxiety that permeates throughout every aspect of my life. It's always there, I'm always on edge, always anticipating something horrible happening. I can't escape it.

Issue 5: How do I spend my free time other than being on my phone? It might be a dumb question, but I am tired of how my phone has dominated my life since I first got it during my adolescence.

Issue 6: I have no friends. I'm essentially entirely alone other than a bit of family. Do I learn to be alone until I better myself or search for people to meet?

I feel embarassed posting this. Hoping for some insight into these issues I haven't overcome.
